description: This file defines the 'Immigration' Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used within the OrangeHRM system to manage and normalize immigration records related to employees. It includes references to employee immigration data and provides methods to convert this data into an array format for further processing or display.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: DTO class for handling employee immigration data, capable of normalizing and retrieving immigration records for an employee.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Immigration DTO with a specific employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the employee's immigration records based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to getter methods for retrieving data from immigration records.
